title: BTP Fiori
description:
* Job Title : Technical Lead
* Job Summary : The Technical Lead role focuses on delivering high\-quality SAP ABAP solutions while leveraging expertise in ABAP Workflow ABAP OOPS WebDynpro and Web Services. The candidate will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design develop and implement SAP solutions that align with business objectives. This hybrid role offers opportunities to work on innovative projects in a dynamic environment.
* Experience : 5
* 8 years
* Required Skills : Technical Skills: SAP ABAP Workflow ABAP OOPS Abap Web Services SAP WebDynpro for Java WebDynpro for ABAP Core ABAP Domain Skills:
* Nice to have skills : Domain Skills:Airport Operations Airlines
* Technology : SAP Managed Services
* Shift : Day
* Responsibilities :
* Develop and implement SAP ABAP solutions including workflows OOPS concepts and WebDynpro applications to meet business requirements and enhance system functionality.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements ensuring alignment with organizational goals and technical feasibility.
* Design and optimize ABAP Web Services and WebDynpro applications to ensure seamless integration and high performance across SAP systems.
* Provide technical expertise and troubleshooting support for SAP ABAP\-related issues ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption to operations.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices coding standards and quality guidelines for SAP ABAP development.
* Work closely with functional teams to understand business processes and translate them into technical solutions within the SAP environment.
* Develop and maintain documentation for SAP ABAP solutions including technical specifications user guides and system configurations.
* Stay updated on the latest SAP technologies and trends applying new knowledge to improve system capabilities and efficiency.
* Test and validate SAP ABAP solutions to ensure they meet functional and technical requirements delivering reliable and robust systems.
* Provide training and mentoring to junior developers fostering skill development and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Collaborate in hybrid work settings ensuring effective communication and coordination between onsite and remote team members.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of SAP systems by identifying opportunities for optimization and innovation.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies standards and security protocols in all SAP ABAP development activities. Qualifications \-
* Demonstrate expertise in SAP ABAP Workflow ABAP OOPS ABAP Web Services WebDynpro for Java WebDynpro for ABAP and Core ABAP with a proven track record of successful implementations.
* Possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address complex technical challenges and deliver effective solutions.
* Showcase excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders effectively.
* Exhibit familiarity with domain knowledge in Airport Operations and Airlines which is considered a valuable asset.
* Have a minimum of 5 years and a maximum of 8 years of relevant experience in SAP ABAP development and related technologies.
* Display adaptability to work in a hybrid model and contribute effectively in both remote and onsite settings.
* Job Location : Primary Location :INWBKOLA09(ITIND Kol\-Candor\-Unit3 BLDG G1\&C1SEZ) Alternate Location :NA NA Alternate Location 1 :NA NA
* Job Type : Sr. Associate
* Projects \[60PM00]
* Demand Requires Travel? : No
* Certifications Required : NA
